title: Set WM_CLASS for every Linux video window
problem: xjadeo's Linux windows have no WM_CLASS, so GNOME cannot associate the running window with the application and shows it as unknown.
reproduce: Launch the current X11 or GLX window and query it with xprop WM_CLASS; the property is absent.
acceptance: Native X11 and GLX windows advertise instance xjadeo and class Xjadeo, while the SDL 1.2 backend supplies the corresponding X11 class before video initialization.
repair: Set an XClassHint in both native X11 window setup paths and SDL_VIDEO_X11_WMCLASS in the SDL backend.

selection.reason: Current master reproduces the missing window-manager identity, the repair is small, and acceptance is measurable with xprop.

verification.limitations: BCL verifies all three backend contracts. The candidate was also fully built and its GLX window returned WM_CLASS(STRING) = xjadeo, Xjadeo under Xvfb.
verification.ownerCheck: Launch the preferred video backend under GNOME and confirm the window is grouped under the xjadeo launcher rather than Unknown.
